geometry_hash_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(items,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True); each drawing item is a list with command string and every fitz.Point converted to [x,y], preserving source order and full floating precision

series.label: BFS
series.identity_reason: Single continuous stroked curve matches BFS solid legend and the central solid trace.

series.label: EFS
series.identity_reason: Filled separated dash footprints match EFS dashed legend and leftmost main rise.

series.label: PC
series.identity_reason: More numerous alternating filled fragments match PC dash-dot legend and trace between EFS and BFS over the main rise.

series.label: sand
series.identity_reason: Right-hand dotted trace with circular sample markers matches Sand legend; path restricted to right-hand size range.

uncertainties: Filled polygon vertices are stroke boundaries, not scientific points. Do not feed directly to old vector percentile extractor.
Separate stroke fragments from circular marker contours; do not connect arbitrary polygon endpoints.
Overlapping plateau curves remain source geometry, not justification for invented hidden points.
Axis interval key is retained for existing coordinate conventions, but units here are PDF points, not raster pixels.
